title.narrative: The Educational Impact of Water Scarcity in Jordan

description.narrative: Our objective is to causally estimate the impact of water scarcity, with a particular interest in studying its impact on children’s educational performances, aspirations, and well-being. We hypothesize that girls are the most vulnerable to water days.
